Annotation.String: The NVIDIA attested wipe resource associated with this manager.

This resource shall represent the NVIDIA attested wipe service associated with this manager. Attested wipe is a cryptographically authorized erasure of selected persistent data. A client shall enroll an ECDSA P-384 public key, retrieve a nonce from the associated root of trust, and submit signatures over that nonce and the wipe configuration so the service can verify that the request is authentic, fresh. The resource shall also contain links to the ComponentIntegrity resources for the roots of trust that participate in the attested wipe sequence.
This action enrolls the public key used to authorize a subsequent attested wipe.

This action shall enroll the public key that the service uses to verify signatures provided to the `AttestedWipe` action. The service shall reject the request if a key is already enrolled and the `Signature` parameter is absent or does not verify against the currently enrolled key.
The hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte ECDSA P-384 public key to enroll.
This parameter shall contain the hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte ECDSA P-384 public key to enroll, expressed as 192 hexadecimal characters.
The hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte signature that authorizes replacing an already enrolled key.

This parameter shall contain the hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte ECDSA P-384 signature, expressed as 192 hexadecimal characters, that the currently enrolled key produced over the new public key and the current nonce. This parameter shall be required if a key is already enrolled.
This action retrieves the current nonce used in signed attested wipe requests.
This action shall return the current nonce that the root of trust associated with this manager requires in signed attested wipe requests.
This action performs an authorized wipe of the data selected in the signed configuration data.
This action shall verify the provided signatures and initiate an attested wipe using the Base64-encoded configuration data.
The hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte signature that authorizes the RoT wipe request, produced over the current nonce.
This parameter shall contain the hexadecimal representation of the ECDSA P-384 signature over the RoT wipe request and the current nonce, expressed as 192 hexadecimal characters without a 0x prefix.
The hexadecimal representation of the 96-byte signature over ConfigData.

This parameter shall contain the hexadecimal representation of the ECDSA P-384 signature over the Base64 ConfigData string exactly as posted, expressed as 192 hexadecimal characters without a 0x prefix.
The Base64-encoded JSON document that selects the data to erase.
This parameter shall contain a Base64-encoded JSON object with the wipe configuration, including optional Settings, BMC, CPUSection, and NICSections properties.
This action retrieves the BMC flash log for attested wipe operations.
This action shall return the BMC flash log that records attested wipe operations and per-section hashes.
The available actions for this resource.
This property shall contain the available actions for this resource.
The links to resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state.
This property shall contain links to resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state for this attested wipe service.
The available actions for this resource.
This type shall contain the available actions for this resource.
The links to resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state.
This type shall contain links to resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state for this attested wipe service.
The ComponentIntegrity resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state.
This property shall contain links to ComponentIntegrity resources that provide attested evidence of the wipe state of the associated roots of trust.
The response from the `GetWipeNonce` action.
This object shall contain the response from the `GetWipeNonce` action.
The hexadecimal representation of the 8-byte current nonce.
This property shall contain the hexadecimal representation of the 8-byte current nonce, expressed as 16 hexadecimal characters.
The response from the `RetrieveFlashLog` action.
This object shall contain the BMC flash log entries returned by the `RetrieveFlashLog` action.
The entries in the BMC flash log.
This property shall contain the BMC flash log entries, ordered from oldest to newest.
An entry in the BMC flash log.
This object shall contain the name and Base64-encoded hash of a BMC flash section.
The name of the BMC flash section.
This property shall contain the name of the BMC flash section.
The Base64-encoded hash of the BMC flash section.
This property shall contain the Base64-encoded hash of the BMC flash section.
